From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Technical evaluation milestone & success criteria (benchmark kickoff)

Emma / Raj — thanks again for a productive demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the Mutual Action Plan technical milestone (please confirm owners / timeline so we can lock the kickoff):

1) Objective: Validate that Redwood meets Acuity's inference SLAs and quality bar for the clinical summarization use case, with metrics that map to production cost and latency targets.

2) Success criteria (pass/fail gating):
- Quality: ROUGE-L and clinical-entity F1 on the supplied gold set >= agreed thresholds (ROUGE-L >= 0.54, entity F1 >= 0.78).
- Latency: p95 generation latency <= 450ms for 256-token response on a 1x dedicated GPU config.
- Cost proxy: tokens-per-USD < 14k (estimated using Redwood cost model) for the evaluation workload.

3) Model shortlist (recommended to run in parallel):
- Mistral-7B-v2 (quantized variant) — low-cost baseline
- RedField-13B (float16) — production-quality candidate
- OpenLlama-34B-QLoRA — high-capacity check (limited runs)

4) Deliverables & owners:
- Acuity: deliver redacted sample dataset + gold references (owner: Emma) — due 2026-07-20
- Redwood SEs: final benchmark plan and prompt harness (owner: Ben) — deliverable 2026-07-17 attached
- Redwood SRE: provision dedicated bench nodes + test routing (owner: Neha) — provisioned by 2026-07-19

5) Kickoff & cadence: kickoff call to walk through the harness and expected outputs: proposed Thu 2026-07-22 10:00 PDT (Ben / Neha / Markus / Emma). Weekly readout every Thursday until agreement.

Attachment: benchmark-plan.xlsx (high-level tests, sample scripts, metric definitions) and sample-prompt-set.jsonl. I attached a short doc with latency/cost target rationales (latency-cost-targets.pdf).

Please confirm: (A) dataset delivery by 7/20, (B) acceptance of the criteria above or suggested edits, and (C) your availability for the kickoff on 7/22. If any of the owners should be different, let me know and I'll update the MAP.

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein

Markus — thanks for the clear recap and for putting the plan into a single place. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Dataset: we can provide a de-identified set of ~2k clinical notes and the gold summaries by 2026-07-20 as requested. Will the sample include some edge cases (long notes >2,000 tokens)? We expect those to be lower priority for the initial run but would like a note on how long-note handling will be measured.

2) Latency target: 450ms p95 looks aggressive for larger context lengths; can Redwood confirm the hardware footprint you’ll use for the 1x config (GPU model/spec)? Also, can you provide p50/p95 breakdown in the benchmark report?

3) Model shortlist: happy with the three candidates. Can you include an accuracy / cost tradeoff table in your readout?

Agree to the kickoff on Thu 7/22 10:00 PDT — Emma will join live; Raj may dial in for the readout sessions.

Emma — quick technical notes to address your questions: 

- Long notes: our benchmark harness supports segmented context evaluation and a "sliding-window" summary scoring method (we'll flag long-note cases separately). For the initial gate we'll report both full-context and segmented metrics; if full-context exceeds token budget we'll report fallbacks.

- Hardware for 1x config: NVIDIA A10G (float16 runtime) replicate — we will record p50/p95/p99. If you prefer A100 for parity with your prod, we can swap but it will change cost estimates.

- Benchmark outputs: we'll include a tradeoff matrix (accuracy vs tokens-per-USD) for each model and a per-test latency table. Ben will attach the harness README and the prompt set.

We've attached the benchmark-plan.xlsx and sample-prompt-set.jsonl (see Drive link in the kickoff invite). Neha is provisioning the bench nodes and will confirm when done.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
